intent: Share a stream-safe spoken answer projection across live playback, replay and captions; omit explicitly nonspoken reasoning, sources and tables by default; preserve normalized numbers, units and pronunciation ranges.

validation.check: Kotlin 2.4.20 standalone JVM compile of production formatter, normalizer and voice dependencies

validation.integration_note: Compiled with the benchmark worktree VoiceSpeechBuffer (shared projection includeDetails, eight-word first phrase and centralized truncation notice). speechChunks was extracted unchanged from production VoiceSession for this host-only test harness.

validation.check: Android application integration and physical device playback
validation.reason: Parent integration task owns Android validation and publication; no compatible physical phone was available to this subtask.

integration_contract.truncation: The shared projection appends LIMIT_NOTICE exactly once at final completion beyond 12000 UTF-16 code units; callers must not append another notice.
integration_contract.source_ranges: Kokoro normalization maps every expanded word to its exact original token span in projected speech; no original-Markdown privacy proof is inferred.
integration_contract.tables: Pipe-prefixed and explicitly wrapped detail tables are nonspoken by default; bare unmarked headers remain stable instead of retracting already streamed words.
